# pidginhost_kubernetes_kubeconfig (Data Source)

The current kubeconfig of a Kubernetes cluster. It holds cluster admin credentials, which Terraform keeps in its state. With Terraform 1.10 or later, use the pidginhost_kubernetes_kubeconfig ephemeral resource instead, which keeps them out of the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_kubernetes_kubeconfig" "example" {
  cluster_id = pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
}

# The kubeconfig holds cluster admin credentials.
resource "local_sensitive_file" "kubeconfig" {
  filename        = "${path.module}/kubeconfig"
  content         = data.pidginhost_kubernetes_kubeconfig.example.kubeconfig
  file_permission = "0600"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the Kubernetes cluster.

### Read-Only

- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig file with cluster admin credentials.
- `valid_until` (String) Time the kubeconfig expires.
